crossRefs.note: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks…
But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;
For what thanksgiving can we render again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before…
saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to…
No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God, in those who are saved and in those who perish:
to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these…
Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.
in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to…
which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since…
if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
translations.bsb: But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
translations.kjv: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth ➔ us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
translations.asv: But thanks be unto God, who always leadeth us in triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest through us the savor of his knowledge in every place.
